summary: Feasibility cannot be established: REQ-5 requires operations from the external ledger service, and policy grants no ledger credential.

findings.problem: REQ-5 'History SHALL include card operations' — card operations exist only in the ledger service (src/integrations/ledger_client.py, LEDGER_TOKEN). factory/policies lists no LEDGER_TOKEN for this repo; no option can satisfy REQ-5 in the sandbox.
findings.expected_fix: Operator grants a scoped read-only ledger credential for test environments, or the feature owner submits a revision; the factory will not drop REQ-5 itself.

checked_criteria: intent_coverage, consistency, testability and risk_controls evaluated
feasibility checked against policy credentials and repo-map trust boundaries
limitations: Feasibility depends on an operator decision outside the analysis rounds

payload.counterexample: Show card operations from a cached CSV fixture: rejected by AC-5, which requires operations created in the ledger test environment to appear within 1 minute.
